_comment: Read by AGENTS.md's 'Printing a status while nothing's been heard from you' house rule (MAT-T108). How often, in minutes, a CLI with outstanding background work and no new user input re-prints its 'Working on: ...' status. Edit intervalMinutes directly; a CLI asked to change it just edits this number and commits. JSON has no real comments, so this key is ignored by anything that reads intervalMinutes.
